userPrompt: Draft a polite reminder email about an overdue invoice.
responseText:
**Subject:** Gentle Reminder: Overdue Invoice #INV-2025-047

Dear [Client's First Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

This is a polite reminder that Invoice #INV-2025-047, issued on [Invoice Date], is now past due. The outstanding balance of $[Amount] was due on [Due Date].

Please let me know if you’ve already processed the payment or if you need a copy of the invoice resent. I’d be grateful if you could arrange settlement at your earliest convenience.

Thank you for your continued partnership. I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

Warm regards,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Company Name]  
[Email Address]  
[Phone Number]
